dedupe_keys.name: elcom switzerland electricity tariffs by operator and municipality

description: ElCom publishes regulated electricity tariff comparisons for Swiss municipalities and distribution operators. The official registry identifies annual coverage from 2009 to 2027. The public portal separates household and business consumption profiles and shows energy, network and levy components. Related registry products provide cantonal and national medians, which are included in this collection-level record. Access is public through the comparison portal, CSV export controls and linked-data distributions using LINDAS SPARQL. The registry assigns the Swiss Open use terms, permitting commercial and non-commercial reuse and recommending source attribution. A limitation is that tariff profiles describe standard consumption categories, not every customer contract or realised wholesale price; future tariff years are published prices, not observations of future consumption. Simulation uses include electricity expenditure scenarios and comparing tariff incentives across service areas. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was identified. The separate ElCom Sunshine efficiency and reliability indicators are not interchangeable with these prices. Registry metadata and portal controls were inspected, but no tariff CSV or SPARQL data result was downloaded.
name: ElCom Switzerland electricity tariffs by operator and municipality
